comment_content:
Preksha Kaparwan Wonderfully said. I will add my pointers.. being a small
player in market - you gotta prove yourself. Hence there is need of free POC
and customer's pain point and what you think is customer pain point are
different. So to assess and build product/service for customer, you need to do
free POC I generally prefer clients who can pay later or who look for long
term relation for a free POC or a domain with which I don't have lot of
learning yet. A lot of clients say - we are long term but from first few
interactions you can assess who actually mean it. In my past experience, most
of times half way through POC, customer has different pain point and want us
to solve and readily pay us in advance. So this is right strategy. Thanks for
putting it out. Being a data guy, the data -  the client shares, the insights
and experiences are much valuable and I generally make a white paper or case
study out of it and publish it. This is a consulting perspective in data
science.
